STAGE: design-space selection for round_20261031_024204_133 (ideation_3, one mechanism).
GOAL: pick ONE coupling position that is materially different from BRad-RQ (behaviour-ranked radial Poincare assignment), CURVCTRL-SID (per-level curvature from prefix transition score), poincare-frechet-successor-codebook (curved successor-weighted Frechet codebook updates), and the cone/prefix/geoshift family, while surviving evidence items 1-4.
READ: the round brief (scope contract + measured evidence from results/research/issue126 and 121) and the prior-round selection list. No repo file access: the working tree is outside my permitted directory, so specs are written from the brief alone.
OBSERVED (from the brief): (a) graph four-point/tree-ness is indistinguishable from a degree-preserving rewiring, so no tree premise; (b) curvature is a gauge (1/sqrt(c) rescaling is exact) and only the Lorentz chart is sound above c~2; (c) the radial coordinate carries group compactness, not hierarchy, and the useful metric family is behaviour CONTRAST, with Euclidean controls matching hyperbolic ones; (d) Gromov-delta and ancestor-depth weighting hurt.
REASONING: the only space left that is both defensible and unused is the QUANTIZATION RESIDUAL itself. Prior rounds changed the codebook (Frechet updates), the level curvature (CURVCTRL) and the item radius (BRad). None changed WHERE the residual is measured from, i.e. the anchor of the log map. If the radial coordinate is the useless part, then a Lorentz (angular-dominant) residual chain plus a behaviour-contrast displacement of the anchor makes level>=2 codes encode behaviour-direction rather than radius. Behaviour is train-only forward/backward transition asymmetry (total variation, in [0,1], no tuning); geometry is the Lorentz log/exp/parallel-transport with curvature -1 fixed by the documented gauge. Single pathway: the anchor q_tilde = exp_q(alpha_i * d(O,q) * u_i) is the SAME object that defines both the residual returned to the next RQ level and the assignment distance, so removing alpha sets delta=0 and removing the Lorentz ops collapses the distance to L2.
OPEN: nothing blocking. Constants are all derived (alpha from TV asymmetry in [0,1]; delta bounded by the codeword's own radius; c fixed at 1 by gauge). Next: write the single answer block.

STAGE: final answer (complete proposal, self-contained).
IDEA: BCGR (behaviour-contrast geodesic residual re-anchoring) in the Lorentz chart.
SUMMARY: replaces the RQ-VAE residual anchor q by q_tilde = exp_q( delta_i * u_i ) with delta_i = alpha_i * d_H(O,q) and u_i = PT_{O->q}(P s_i / ||P s_i||); alpha_i is the train-only forward/backward transition total-variation asymmetry of item i, s_i the successor-averaged frozen side embedding, P a learned linear map. The residual PT_{q_tilde->O}( log_{q_tilde}(z) ) is what level l+1 quantizes, and every assignment uses the Lorentz distance. Switches: behaviour-off (alpha=0, u=0), geometry-off (Euclidean exp/log/PT and L2 assignment), both-on (full). Cost at the frozen scale (24556 items, 24 steps/epoch, 3000 epochs): +~1-2% epoch wall clock, one-time sparse transition count pass, no extra codebook entries.
The full block is printed in the response, in the required label format, and is the authoritative record.
